topic.angle: A crash on the first login

card.title: The ARPANET’s first two characters were "lo"

panels.text: 29 October 1969, 10:30 pm. UCLA student programmer Charley Kline connects to a computer at the Stanford Research Institute.
He types the command "login". But after two characters, the computer at the other end crashes.
About an hour later, SRI programmer Bill Duvall adjusts parameters on the machine. Kline tries again and logs in.
So the first two characters successfully transmitted over the ARPANET were "lo".

probes.question: Which two characters were the first successfully transmitted over the ARPANET?
True or false: the second login attempt, about an hour later, worked.
